tips.text: Rank one Cernos to 30 before you build Mutalist Cernos; the build consumes it and its Mastery is lost otherwise.
Gather Ferrite and Polymer Bundle on Mercury first, then finish with Plastids and Gallium on Uranus before you build.
Nobody complains about this farm; the Cernos is a starter bow and an easy Mastery Rank item.
